title: THE LOCKDOWN FENCES PLAYER 2 TOO
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the raid flow batch must work for both players. The lockdown alarm seals a district for 60 seconds: nobody crosses the ring. That was true of player 1 and of the machines, which the host moves, but player 2 walks in his own window, so the fence was not there for him. Player 2 now takes his side of the ring the moment the doors slam (inside is SEALED IN, outside is DISTRICT SEALED), is put back on his side if he tries to cross, and is told DOORS OPEN when the seal lifts and LOCKDOWN OVER when it ends.
now: The lockdown alarm now seals player 2 in or out of the ring as well, then opens its doors.
